entries.en: Ahtbyrm is looking for a member of his crew and the items he was supposed to deliver.
entries.fr: Ahtbyrm a besoin de quelqu'un pour vérifier que le bac est bien arrivé au quai de la Torche.
entries.ja: ナルディク＆ヴィメリー社の筆頭造船師アートビルムは、キャンドルキープ埠頭に、連絡船が到着したかを確認したいようだ。
entries.section: Main Scenario (A Realm Reborn through Endwalker)
entries.category: Seventh Umbral Era Main Scenario Quests

entries.en: Take the road leading west from the Moraby Drydocks and speak with Haldbroda regarding the whereabouts of one Fyrilsmyd, making sure to express your /doubt concerning his honesty.
entries.fr: Ahtbyrm vous a proposé de <italic(1)>questionner<italic(0)> le marin Haldbroda au quai de la Torche pour savoir ce qui est arrivé au bac.
entries.ja: キャンドルキープ埠頭の水夫「ハルドブロダ」にエモート「問い詰める」をして、連絡船の運行状況を聞きだそう。
entries.frMacro: Ahtbyrm vous a proposé de <italic(1)>questionner<italic(0)> le marin Haldbroda au quai de la Torche pour savoir ce qui est arrivé au bac.
entries.section: Main Scenario (A Realm Reborn through Endwalker)
entries.category: Seventh Umbral Era Main Scenario Quests

entries.en: It appears that Haldbroda truly does not recall ever seeing Fyrilsmyd. Could it be that the young shipwright was somehow caught up in the tragedy that claimed a ship off of the Salt Strand?
entries.fr: Haldbroda vous a appris que le bac avait eu un accident lors duquel il était peut-être arrivé quelque chose à l'ouvrier naval Fyrilsmyd.
entries.ja: 連絡船は、海難事故に巻き込まれていた。行方不明になっている造船師フィリルスミッドの安否が気になるところだ。
entries.section: Main Scenario (A Realm Reborn through Endwalker)
entries.category: Seventh Umbral Era Main Scenario Quests

entries.en: Journey to Candlekeep Quay and relay Ahtbyrm's /doubt to Haldbroda.

entries.ja: ハルドブロダに「問い詰める」をする

entries.en: Where in the seven hells is that man!? Not once in twelve moons has he been late with a shipment, and now two whole turns of the sun without a single word.
entries.fr: Raah<nbsp>! Mais pourquoi il ne revient pas<nbsp>!? Et pourquoi je n'ai aucune nouvelle...<nbsp>!?
entries.ja:
ったく、困ったことになったな……
いつになったら、アイツぁ戻るんだ……。

entries.en: A shipwright of mine─a young man named Fyrilsmyd─recently left Candlekeep Quay to retrieve several crates of supplies ordered from Limsa Lominsa...but has yet to return.
entries.fr: Ah, salut. J'ai envoyé un de mes ouvriers, Fyrilsmyd, chercher des pièces pour le vaisseau que nous con<->strui<->sons ac<->tu<->el<->le<->ment, mais il tarde à revenir.
entries.ja:
うちの造船師フィリルスミッドが
船の部材を仕入れに出て、まだ戻らないんだ。

entries.en: I have sent several missives to Haldbroda, but his replies are always the same. He does not recall ever seeing the wright, nor the supplies he was scheduled to collect. That man knows something, and I severely <colortype(500)><edgecolortype(501)>doubt<edgecolortype(0)><colortype(0)> he is telling me the whole truth.

entries.en: As I cannot leave my post, I would ask you to travel to Candlekeep Quay in my stead and inform Haldbroda that if he insists on playing these games, I will personally see that he is transferred to Turtleback Island, where he can rot alone in the middle of the sea for eternity.
entries.fr: Dis, tu ne voudrais pas aller là-bas et demander ce qu'il en est à Haldbroda<nbsp>? Ce marin n'est pas très loquace, mais si tu le <italic(1)>questionnes<italic(0)>, il sera forcé de te dire ce qu'il sait.

entries.en: I swear on my poor nana's grave, Navigator rest her soul, I know naught of this Fyrilsmyd, nor his precious supplies.

entries.en: Hells, we here at the Quay have had enough trouble these past few suns, what with the sinking of that Lominsan cargo ship off the Salt Strand. I haven't the time to take a proper piss, let alone make note of every scrag that wanders in off the Grip.
entries.fr: S'il était à bord du bac, il est peut-être tombé au moment de l'accident. C'est étrange quand même, parce qu'il y avait un marin vétéran aux commandes... Mais qu'est-ce qui a bien pu se passer...<nbsp>?
entries.ja:
もしかして、事故で海に放り出されたんじゃ……！？
ああ、ベテラン水夫が乗船していながら、
どうして、こんなことに……！
